It seems that there is no Makefile in the repository to build the code. I will create a simple Makefile to compile `texturing/tex1dfetch_host.cu` with CUDA 12.8.

Let's create a Makefile and add the necessary commands to build the program.

arguments.content:
# Makefile
CC = nvcc
CFLAGS = -arch=sm_90

all: tex1dfetch_host

tex1dfetch_host: tex1dfetch_host.cu
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) $< -o $@
